assumptions: CFBD's lines endpoint returns pregame lines only; a CFBD line fetched after kickoff is the game's pregame consensus line (supported by the CFBD re-fetch comparison, not by provider documentation)
capture times are fetch times; the audit shows a line was fetched before kickoff, not when the book posted it
later provider corrections to past weeks were adopted (event-time cutoffs hold)

limits: Statistics are compared with a rebuild from the recorded source versions after independently excluding every same/later-week game.
